knownDefectReproduction.claim: default bb_health exceeded a 30 s MCP client timeout on the ~1.28M-symbol workspace index while bb_analyze stats answered

servedIndexFacts.note: The live bb MCP server in this DSH profile is started as `bin/bb mcp --dir <repo>` with NO BB_DATA_DIR, so it serves the default data dir ~/.bb, not .bb-data.

mcpDoorObservation.client: the configured DSH bb MCP client (toolCallTimeoutMs=120000 in ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml)
mcpDoorObservation.interpretation: the default call did not answer within the 120 s client timeout on the served ~/.bb index (17 GB db + 8.7 GB WAL against 15 GB RAM, 1.28M symbols); a subsequent bb_search call returned `Cannot find module dist/symbol-search-SCZXX3WR.js`, i.e. the server's lazy imports were invalidated by a concurrent dist rebuild, so no further live-door probes were possible

controlledReproduction.fixture: validation/tools/bb_health/bbdata/projects/<workspace-pid>/brain.db — a copy of the .bb-data index with symbols raised to the charter's reference count (1,283,638); triggers dropped, ANALYZE run. Built by validation/tools/bb_health/work/build-scale-copy.sh
controlledReproduction.verdict: REPRODUCES the >30 s defect: first default call 76.7 s (2.56x the 30 s client timeout); warm p50 12.8 s. Same code, same default arguments; the difference from T2 is the per-symbol work the default call does unconditionally.

mechanismColdProfileOnT2.note: per-query timings from validation/tools/bb_health/work/profile-queries.cjs, first (cold) pass on .bb-data; these eight aggregates all run on a DEFAULT call today
mechanismColdProfileOnT2.note2: the two O(symbols) correlated EXISTS probes (kindsWithNoEmbeddings, embeddedByLanguage) and the O(symbols) JOIN/group-bys exist only to feed verbose output (languages, searchable-by-language, embedded/unembedded kinds) yet are computed on every default call; at 1.28M symbols they scale ~4.1x
